text:
Maya Chen: Product wants better behaviour when embeds are oversize. Currently 413 and a vague msg. Options: better hint header, server-side inline split for small cases, or async split job. pros/cons?
Kevin Patel: Prefer hint header first. Inline split touches IO and latency SLOs. Async split complicates lifecycle.
Amanda R: What should the hint include? dims, per-item bytes, suggested splits? SDKs could auto-retry with that info.
Maya Chen: Proposal: 413 + header like `X-Embed-Reject-Info: dims=512;oversize_by_bytes=23400;suggested_split=3` and routing tag `X-Embed-Routing-Class: reject_hint`. Console surfaces a "why rejected" card.
Oliver: Concern: not all clients will implement retry. Maybe server_inline for small requests: <=50 items && dims uniform; otherwise 413+hint.
Sasha: Telemetry needs new tags: routing_class=reject_hint|autosplit_inline|autosplit_async and split_strategy. Add metrics for reject.rate and autosplit rates.
Kevin Patel: Dashboard idea: panel showing reject vs autosplit ratio and heatmap bytes vs dims. Also alert on sudden autosplit.inline spikes.
Amanda R: Console feature flag `embed_autosplit_inline` so we can roll out to a subset of tenants. UI should show sample offending items for support.
Maya Chen: Rollout: FF off -> 5% tenants 24h -> 20% -> 50% while monitoring embed.latency.P95, disk IO, and autosplit queue length. Auto-revert on regressions.
Oliver: I'll add a cheap `dims_uniform()` check and estimator for `suggested_split` (bytes/dim heuristics). Bench numbers will be posted.
Sasha: Metrics list: embed.reject.count, embed.autosplit.inline.count, embed.autosplit.async.queued, embed.client_retry.rate, embed.latency.P95_by_path. Tag by tenant_id and route.
Amanda R: UX: rejection card shows short actionable text: "Try smaller batches or client-side split. See hints in header/console." plus a payload sample and link to trace.
Maya Chen: Example response header we discussed:
```
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
Content-Type: application/json
X-Embed-Reject-Info: dims=1536;max_per_item=8192;oversize_by_bytes=34210;suggested_split=4
X-Embed-Routing-Class: reject_hint
```
Kevin Patel: Make suggested_split optional when estimation not possible.
Oliver: API debate: accept mixed-dimension payloads and normalize vs reject. Normalization hides client bugs and adds GPU cost.
Sasha: If we normalize, tag normalization=up|down|none and sample outputs for QA. Watch privacy implications.
Amanda R: Need a cost estimate for server-side normalization (per 1k requests) so product can weigh.
Maya Chen: Ops: ensure tmp files from inline splits are cleaned on failure. Add e2e tests for leak scenarios.
Kevin Patel: Implementation TODOs: 1) add header + 413 path (eng-runtime), 2) telemetry tags & metrics (eng-platform), 3) console card + heatmap (console), 4) FF + rollout playbook (releases).
Oliver: I'll open a runtime PR with dims_uniform helper and suggested_split estimator.
deploy-bot: canary deploy of embed-routing-v2 scheduled to prod-canary at 1749990000 :rocket:
Sasha: Rollout checklist: dashboard with alert for autosplit spikes >10x baseline, runbook link, sample trace retention 48h.
Amanda R: UX nit: error copy short and actionable: "Try batching smaller items or enable client-side split; see console for hints."
Maya Chen: I'll mock the console card and post in #design, and follow up with telemetry dimension sizes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
